datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule across Niger administrative areas. The data represents medium-term projections of acute food insecurity phases, spatially distributed as geographic features with classification values and collection metadata.
